name: Checkmk
description: Gives AI clients the service problems and the host states of a Checkmk site (2.1 or later, REST API) together with the Phoedox entry each host belongs to (matched by host name or address). Read-only, no import. Settings: url (the site address, e.g. https://monitoring.example.org/mysite), username and secret (an automation user that may see the hosts and services in question; monitoring read access is enough). The plugin reads the knowledge graph only to find matching entries.

mcpTools.name: checkmk.problems
mcpTools.description: Services that are not OK (WARN, CRIT, UNKNOWN): host, service, state, plugin output, since when, acknowledged and the matching Phoedox entry.

mcpTools.name: checkmk.hosts
mcpTools.description: Hosts with address, state (UP, DOWN, UNREACHABLE) and the matching Phoedox entry.
